## Closed `not_planned` — a drift risk with no defect today is an observation

Path: fleet decision — none nameable | 缺项 | none

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T19:43Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, and objectui `origin/main`.

The card says so itself: the two inspector copies of the failed-roster notice match today, so nothing renders wrong. A hand-kept duplicate that might drift later is an observation, which the filing gate keeps off the board. It goes to the `## Acceptance notes` of the PR that next changes the notice.

Carrier: the next PR that changes the roster-failure notice in either copy (`inspectors/_shared.tsx`'s `InspectorSelectField` failure arm, or `HookDefaultInspector.tsx`) exports one `RosterFailureNotice` and has both copies render it, keeping each `data-testid`. None is in flight today.

Reopen when the two copies measurably differ (role, tone, key or accessible name).
